privacy.title: Wallet privacy policy
paragraphs: Updated 24 September 2026. This policy describes the SWARM Wallet iOS beta distributed by S4FE AG. For privacy questions and requests, email swarmofficial@atomicmail.io.

On your device: the wallet stores recovery material, addresses, address labels, transaction history, memos and settings to provide wallet functions. iOS protects the wallet files in the app sandbox. Wallet files and saved wallets are excluded from iCloud device backups. If you enable recovery-phrase storage, the app stores that recovery material in the device Keychain.

paragraphs.swarm-mainnet: Wallet servers: the app connects to the selected server to obtain blockchain information, synchronize balances and submit transactions. The default server on SWARM Mainnet is https://lwd-main.swarm.green:8443. A server can observe your IP address, connection times and requests. Requests involving transparent addresses can expose those addresses. Shielded transactions protect transaction details on the blockchain, while network metadata has separate privacy limits. Server operators control their own service logs. Ask our support address for the default service's current logging and retention details.
paragraphs.swarm-testnet: Wallet servers: the app connects to the selected server to obtain blockchain information, synchronize balances and submit transactions. The default server on SWARM Testnet is https://lwd.swarm.green:443. A server can observe your IP address, connection times and requests. Requests involving transparent addresses can expose those addresses. Shielded transactions protect transaction details on the blockchain, while network metadata has separate privacy limits. Server operators control their own service logs. Ask our support address for the default service's current logging and retention details.

paragraphs: Blockchain records: submitted transactions are distributed to network participants. Transparent transaction details are public. Shielded transaction contents are encrypted for the relevant wallets. Recipients can retain information you send them, including memos. Confirmed blockchain records cannot be edited or deleted by the wallet publisher.

Camera and device authentication: camera access is used to read QR codes on the device. The app processes scanned codes locally. Face ID or device authentication returns an authentication result to the app. Biometric templates remain under the operating system's control.

Diagnostics and support: Apple processes TestFlight installation, usage, crash and feedback information under its TestFlight terms and privacy policy. If you submit feedback or send support email, Apple or your email provider handles the information you choose to include. Include only the details needed to reproduce the issue. Keep recovery phrases and private keys out of feedback and email.

External services: opening a website or block explorer transfers the displayed URL to your browser. That service can receive your IP address and the URL, including a transaction identifier when present. The app contains no advertising SDK or cross-app tracking. This build disables third-party name resolution and price lookup.

Retention and deletion: local wallet information remains until you remove the app or its data. Save each recovery phrase before removing wallet data. iOS Keychain entries can survive app deletion. Turn off recovery-phrase storage in Settings before uninstalling to remove that optional Keychain copy. Deleting the app does not delete blockchain records or copies retained by recipients, Apple, email providers or network operators. Send questions about support records, access, correction or deletion to swarmofficial@atomicmail.io.
Changes: future builds may update this policy when wallet functions or data handling change. Read the current policy inside About and at https://swarm.green/wallet/privacy.

terms.title: Wallet terms of use
paragraphs: Updated 24 September 2026. SWARM Wallet is experimental, self-custody software distributed for testing by S4FE AG. Support is available at swarmofficial@atomicmail.io.

paragraphs.swarm-mainnet: This release connects to SWARM Mainnet, the live SWARM network. The SWM it holds is real and a confirmed transaction is final. You alone hold the keys, and the publisher can neither restore a balance nor reverse a payment.
paragraphs.swarm-testnet: This build connects to SWARM Testnet. SWM test coins have no monetary value. The test network may reset, change or stop. A test balance creates no entitlement to a coin or network.

paragraphs: You control your recovery phrases and wallet keys. Keep an offline copy of each wallet's recovery phrase. Anyone who obtains that phrase can control its wallet. The publisher cannot recover a lost phrase or reverse a confirmed transaction.

Check the destination address, network, amount and fee before sending. Use the software in accordance with the laws that apply to you. The app provides wallet functions and does not provide financial, investment, legal or tax advice.

The software may contain errors affecting balances, synchronization, privacy or availability. The applicable open-source licences provide the software as is and describe their warranty and liability terms. Read Open-source notices for the licence text. Rights that applicable law makes mandatory continue to apply.

Apple's TestFlight terms govern your use of TestFlight. Apple's standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement applies to App Store distribution where applicable, together with the applicable open-source licences. Apple's standard agreement is available at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/.
Read the Wallet privacy policy and Risk notice before using the app. These describe the beta's data flows and practical limits.
